{"meta":{},"result":{"jobOpening":{"jobOpeningShareUrl":"https://volanteoneteam.bamboohr.com/careers/114","jobOpeningName":"Principal, AI Engineer","jobOpeningStatus":"Open","jobCategoryId":null,"departmentId":"20372","departmentLabel":"Engineering - Product","employmentStatusLabel":"Full-Time","employmentType":null,"location":{"city":"Pune","state":null,"postalCode":"411 057","addressCountry":"India"},"atsLocation":{"country":null,"countryId":null,"state":null,"city":null},"description":" About Us 
 Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments. 
 
 Role Summary 
 We are seeking a Principal AI Engineer to provide technical leadership for the enterprise AI platform and AI-powered products. This individual will define architecture, establish engineering standards, drive AI innovation, and mentor engineering teams. 
 
 What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) 
 Technical Leadership 
 
 Define enterprise AI architecture and technology roadmap. 
 Lead design and implementation of AI platforms, AI agents, and AI-powered products. 
 Drive adoption of GenAI across software engineering, operations, and customer-facing products. 
 Establish standards for model selection, evaluation, governance, security, and observability. 
 Review architecture and provide technical direction for critical initiatives. 
 
   
 Platform Engineering 
 
 Build scalable AI platforms supporting RAG, Agentic Workflows, MCP Integrations, Multi-model Orchestration, Model Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Management, and AI Observability. 
 Design AI infrastructure leveraging cloud-native technologies. 
 
   
 Engineering Excellence 
 
 Define coding standards and AI engineering best practices. 
 Establish AI SDLC processes. 
 Drive CI/CD and MLOps adoption. 
 Lead performance optimization and cost governance initiatives. 
 
   
 Innovation 
 
 Evaluate emerging AI technologies and foundation models. 
 Define build-vs-buy strategies. 
 Drive POCs and incubate new AI capabilities. 
 Collaborate with customers and business stakeholders to identify AI opportunities. 
 
 People Leadership 
 
 Mentor junior and senior AI engineers. 
 Conduct technical interviews and talent assessments. 
 Develop AI competency frameworks. 
 Act as a technical advisor to engineering leadership. 
 
 
 What You Bring (Skills & Qualifications) 
 Required Skills: 
 
 LLMs, Foundation Models, Agentic AI, RAG, Fine-tuning, Prompt Engineering 
 AI Governance and Responsible AI 
 Python, Java, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices 
 LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel 
 MLFlow, Azure ML, SageMaker, Model Lifecycle Management 
 Vector Databases, Data Pipelines, Knowledge Graphs 
 Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD Platforms 
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 
 10–15+ years in software engineering. 
 5+ years in AI/ML or Data Engineering. 
 2+ years in Generative AI solutions. 
 Experience leading enterprise-scale AI implementations. 
 Experience mentoring engineering teams and influencing executive stakeholders. 
 
 
 Success Metrics: 
 
 AI platform adoption across product teams. 
 Delivery of production-grade AI solutions. 
 Reduction in AI operational costs. 
 AI model quality and reliability. 
 Engineering productivity improvements. 
 Talent development and technical leadership impact. 
 
 
 What We Offer 
 ✔ Competitive compensation ✔ Health benefits ✔ Remote/flexible work options ✔ Professional development support 
   
 📍 Location Pune/Hyderabad/Chennai 
   
 Equal Opportunity Statement: 
 At Volante Technologies, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion fuels success. We are committed to creating a performance driven workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and ensure equitable opportunities for growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. Together as ONE TEAM, we celebrate differences and foster collaboration, creativity, and belonging. closest.title: Junior Hardware Design Engineer
closest.text: Hardware Design Engineer – VIM (IoT) Vecmocon Technologies Pvt. Ltd. • Noida, India • Experience: 2 years • Full-time About the Role You will own hardware quality for Vecmocon’s VIM (IoT) modules — the connected “brain” of the vehicle. Beyond running tests and circuit simulation you will bring up, validate, and debug VIM hardware and integrate it with our BMS and charging systems. This is a hands-on validation and design-support role. Key Responsibilities VIM Validation: Design and execute DVP / DVT for Vehicle Interface Modules (IoT) in EV applications — power rails, peripherals, connectivity (cellular / GNSS / BLE) and CAN. Board Bring-up & Testing: Bring up new boards and ensure full validation coverage before handover, using oscilloscope / DSO, multimeter, logic analyser and electronic load. System Integration: Ensure the VIM communicates reliably with the BMS and Charger across the EV ecosystem. Debugging & RCA: Diagnose hardware failures and produce formal RCA in the Vecmocon standard format ; maintain a hardware bug log. Connectivity & Compliance: Validate antenna and server-connectivity performance and get understanding to run EMI / EMC pre-compliance checks. Design Support: Contribute to component selection and schematic review. Documentation & Field Support: Maintain DVP reports, test plans and change-logs; willing to travel for on-site testing and integration. Who You Are (Required Skills) Experience: 1–2 years in electronics hardware testing / validation (BMS,VIM or general electronics backgrounds are encouraged). Education: B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or a related field. Core Electronics: Strong fundamentals — power supplies, MCU peripherals, reading schematics / datasheets — plus PCB-level testing and troubleshooting. Tools: Confident with lab equipment (DSO, multimeter, logic analyser) and soldering of SMD and through-hole components. Software: MS-Excel for data interpretation; Python for test automation is a plus. Mindset: Strong problem-solving, structured root-cause analysis, ownership and clear communication. We’ll Train You On These IoT protocols / telematics and server connectivity. VIM / IoT assembly and the Vecmocon standard DVP and RCA processes. EMI / EMC pre-compliance and thermal / environmental validation.

closest.title: SRE
closest.text: The Impact You’ll Drive We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of Vegapay's production systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring applications and infrastructure, managing production alerts, overseeing critical end-of-day processing and driving incident resolution through effective triage and escalation. The Hats You Will Wear Monitor application health checks and ensure high system availability. Monitor infrastructure health, including servers, databases, network components, and cloud resources. Continuously track Grafana dashboards to identify performance bottlenecks, traffic spikes, and production anomalies. Monitor and manage end-of-day (EOD) batch processing jobs, scheduled tasks, and cron executions. Monitor end-of-day reporting jobs and ensure timely completion of core system and operational reports. Review, acknowledge, and respond to production alerts across monitoring platforms. Create, manage, and track incidents through closure, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs. Perform initial triage, coordinate with engineering teams, and follow the escalation matrix for issue resolution. Maintain incident logs, post-incident documentation, and operational runbooks. Participate in on-call rotations and support critical production activities when required. Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency improvements. The Perfect Fit 2+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, or Infrastructure Operations. Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience monitoring scheduled jobs, batch processing systems, and cron-based workflows. Knowledge of incident management processes and production support best practices. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-availability production environment The Problem We’re Solving Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences. At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction. This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.

closestEng.title: Senior AI Engineer
closestEng.text: The Impact You’ll Drive As a Senior AI Engineer , you will be a senior technical voice on the AI & Data Platform team - independently leading the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML systems that power real-time credit decisions, fraud detection, personalised experiences, operational intelligence and productivity improvements at scale. You will own full problem spaces end-to-end, mentor junior engineers, and shape how Vegapay thinks about AI-native product development. The Hats You Will Wear Design and build production-grade ML models for credit underwriting, risk scoring, and fraud detection on TB-scale transaction data. Architect and maintain low-latency AI inference pipelines integrated with UPI payment flows and the CLOU credit lifecycle. Lead the AI feature roadmap for one or more product domains - from problem framing through deployment and monitoring. Evaluate and integrate LLM and GenAI capabilities into internal tooling, operations automation, and customer-facing features. Build and maintain robust data pipelines (ClickHouse, Spark, Kafka) that feed model training and real-time inference. Define and enforce ML engineering best practices — versioning, experimentation frameworks, model observability, and drift detection. Collaborate directly with product, credit, and engineering teams to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions. Mentor L1/L2 engineers; conduct design and code reviews; raise the technical bar across the team. The Perfect Fit 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with at least 3 years focused on ML/AI systems in production. Strong foundations in machine learning - supervised/unsupervised learning, gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), deep learning, and model evaluation. Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow or similar experiment tracking. Experience with real-time and batch data infrastructure: Kafka, Spark, Flink, ClickHouse, or equivalent. Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and embedding-based systems. Solid software engineering fundamentals - clean code, distributed systems, REST/gRPC APIs, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes).st product. Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or credit is a strong plus — understanding of risk, compliance, and regulated data environments. Customer obsession - you think about end-user impact, not just model metrics. Highest standards - you are not satisfied shipping 80%; you care about correctness, reliability, and edge cases. Full ownership - you treat problems as yours until they are solved, not until the code is merged. AI-native - you actively use AI tools in your own workflow and push the team to build AI-first by default. Edge Over Rest Experience with credit scoring models, bureau data (CIBIL, Experian), or alternative data underwriting. Contributions to open-source ML projects or published research. Familiarity with NPCI's UPI ecosystem, RBI regulatory guidelines for digital lending, or CLOU product architecture. nearMatches.title: Android Developer
nearMatches.text: About Us Visit Health is a pioneering health-tech platform, founded in 2016 by BITS Pilani alumni, dedicated to making healthcare accessible, affordable, and preventive. Originated as a telemedicine platform during the 2015 Swine Flu epidemic, Visit Health has grown into an all-in-one wellness ecosystem that connects doctors, insurers, and millions of Indian families. Our services range from physical and mental wellness to OPD benefits, empowering both individuals and corporations to prioritize well-being. Our Core Offerings - Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Mental health support services for a balanced work-life experience. - Personalized Health Plans: Tailored wellness programs with fitness, meditation, and nutritional guidance. - Health Check-ups & Screenings: Preventive check-ups and vaccinations for proactive health management. - Comprehensive Wellness Programs: Designed to boost morale, productivity, and holistic employee health. - Preventive & OPD Care: Seamless primary care and OPD services, reducing out-of-pocket expenses through cashless OPD benefits. Founding Team The founding team — Chetan Anand, Anurag Prasad, Vaibhav Singh, and Shashvat Tripathi — established Visit Health to bridge the healthcare gap in India. Driven by their experiences with limited healthcare access in Pilani, they have built Visit Health into a platform that advocates quality, accessible healthcare for everyone. What Sets Us Apart - Comprehensive & Flexible OPD Benefits: Visit offers unlimited access packages for employees and dependents, covering mental health, nutrition, diagnostics, and doctor consultations. - Integrated Platform: Combining primary and secondary care, our platform connects corporates, insurers, and retailers, making healthcare seamless and holistic. - Engagement & Gamification: AI-driven insights, step challenges, and rewards (FitCoins) drive high engagement and builds lasting healthy habits. - 24/7 Accessibility: Accessible health support anytime, designed to address India’s diverse healthcare needs. Key Milestones & Achievements - Expanding Primary Care Access: Serving over 5 million users with 1.5 million annual health checkups, 500,000 doctor consultations, and 200,000 pharmacy orders. - Strategic Partnerships: Collaborations with leading insurers and doctors, reaching 2,500 major Indian corporations and MSMEs. - Technological Innovation: Introduced India’s first cashless OPD insurance program in partnership with Apollo Munich, with a network of over 35,000 doctors. - Awards & Recognition: Honored in Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia (2020) and BITSAA Global 30 Under 30 (2022). - Funding Success: Secured over $40 million in investments to drive growth and service expansion. Future Vision Visit Health aims to further strengthen India’s primary care infrastructure, expand its corporate and insurer partnerships, and introduce advanced health tech solutions. With a focus on universal health coverage, we’re committed to making healthcare accessible for all employees and their families, supporting them in leading healthier lives. Visit Health — Empowering workplaces with accessible, affordable, and impactful healthcare. As part of your day-to-day work, you will be Translating design specs into quality code Push pixel perfect designs, ship awesome features, and delight customers. Spec, build, test, and deliver new features while improving the performance and quality of the product. Create front-end modules with maximum code reusability and efficiency Must have’s Min Relevant exp: 2 years Strong knowledge of Kotlin/Java Android SDK and Jetpack Library(ViewModel, LIveData, Workmanager, Room, Navigation, etc) Android UI design principles, patterns, and best practices Experience with offline storage, threading (RxJava and Coroutines) Good knowledge of the open-source Android ecosystem and the libraries available for common tasks. Proficient in Google’s Android design principles, interface guidelines and code versioning tools, such as Git. Experience is Jetpack Compose and its companion libraries is preferable. Understanding of basic App architectures (ie MVP/MVVM)

Job Summary We are seeking a highly motivated and independent Mobile Developer to focus on our iOS applications. This role requires a strong combination of ReactNative expertise for cross-platform efficiency and deep NativeiOS (Swift/Objective-C) knowledge for integrating custom modules, adhering to Apple's guidelines, and optimizing performance. Key Responsibilities ● Independent Ownership: Take full responsibility for the development, debugging, and deployment of features within the iOS application, operating with minimal supervision. ● Hybrid Development: Build and maintain features using ReactNative (TypeScript/JavaScript) , ensuring a unified and performant experience across platforms. ● NativeIntegration: Design, develop, and maintain NativeiOS modules (Swift/Objective-C) to seamlessly integrate ReactNative with platform-specific APIs, hardware features, and custom UI components. ● Performance & Quality: Optimize app performance, battery usage, and ensure compliance with Apple's Human Interface Guidelines . ● Collaboration: Work closely with the product team and backend engineers to define clear technical requirements and architecture. ● Deployment: Manage the full application lifecycle from development through to submission on the Apple App Store (App Store Connect) . Required Skills & Experience ● Minimum 2 years of professional experience in mobile application development. ● Strong proficiency in ReactNative development and its ecosystem (component lifecycle, state management, debugging). ● Proven experience developing applications using NativeiOS (Swift or Objective-C). ● Deep understanding of the iOS SDK, UIKit/SwiftUI, and Apple's development environment . ● Expertise in state management libraries (e.g., Redux, MobX, Zustand). ● Experience with dependency management (CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager). ● Ability to integrate third-party libraries and handle API consumption (REST, GraphQL). ● Proficiency with Git version control and modern development tooling (Xcode, VS Code).

matches.title: Systems Test Engineer, Early Career
matches.text: About us One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. What you'll do In this role you will be able to use your engineering skills to support the next generation of advanced communications products and systems. You will be responsible for performing test engineering activities for RF/Microwave products and sub-assemblies developed for commercial, military and space markets. You will provide support in the Development of new Test Stations and participate in the Design Verification Testing of new products. You will plan and execute test tasks that include interpreting test requirements, writing test plans, designing test hardware, designing test software and support characterization, testing and debugging devices for commercial, military, and space markets. Ideal candidates have a diverse engineering background or an interest in becoming diverse in software and hardware engineering. The day-to-day Work with designers to gather test requirements Develop Test Plans Develop Test Station Hardware Select appropriate Test equipment Develop test software Build Test Stations Test station calibration Troubleshoot and problem-solving on Viasat hardware Data Analysis of test results Write Test and or Calibration procedures Testing of custom RF hardware Create HW and SW documentation Additional Details This position is site-based. Site ‑ based employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five ‑ day work week. Relocation assistance is available pending eligibility. What you'll need Education: Completion of Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field Experience: This role is intended for someone with 0-3 years of full-time, relevant industry experience Citizenship: This position requires U.S. Citizenship A good understanding of Electrical Circuit Designs and ability to read design documentation Proficiency with programming in one or more programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, or C++ Communication skills Up to 10% travel Ability to obtain and maintain a United States Secret Clearance What will help you on the job Desire to work in an engineering environment Good problem-solving skills, and tolerance for ambiguity Working knowledge of object-oriented programming and software development best practices Ability to work in teams or be self-directed Salary range $77,000.00 - $122,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $96,000.00- $144,000.00/ annually At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. closestEng.text: Job Title Mechanical Project Engineer-I Job Description Revit Layout Engineer | Pune | Full-time We are seeking a senior-level Revit Layout Engineer who can take ownership of modelling, clash coordination, and interface management. You will work closely with multi-disciplinary teams, lead small layout teams, and act as the go-to person for Revit and BIM issues. This role also involves mentoring others, improving modelling workflows, and actively resolving complex coordination issues. Conveyor system knowledge is a plus but not a must. What you will do System & Layout Design Lead Revit layout efforts during engineering and pre-sales phase. Translate functional requirements into efficient mechanical designs. Optimize layouts for safety, maintenance, and access. Coordinate interfaces with buildings, operators, equipment, and procurement. Contribute to layout standards and process improvements. 3D Modeling, 2D Drafting & Documentation Create and manage 3D conveyor models in Revit based on design inputs and extract 2D drawings. Review Revit and BIM deliverables and Maintain Documentation. Incorporate functional attributes and prepare equipment specifications. Ensure drawing and documentation quality across the team. Sound knowledge on BIM 360 Documentation Project Execution & Coordination Lead layout engineering teams and liaise with clients and suppliers. Support site activities including installation files, test plans, and as-built documentation. Planning & Budgeting Estimate timelines, resources, and budgets for mechanical scope. Define mechanical work packages and manage delivery tracking. Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Sharing Act as Revit lead for the team; resolve advanced issues. Mentor new engineers and share project learnings. Suggest improvements in modeling workflows and template content. Create Training materials, transfer knowledge between teams and across projects. Should take ownership in work. What you bring Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Revit modeling and parametric families Experienced in Navisworks clash detection and resolution Familiarity with MS Office Strong understanding of mechanical systems, layouts, and site coordination Good knowledge of Revit templates, view control, and documentation standards Understanding of engineering processes Ability to guide standardization of modeling practices Sound knowledge on BIM 360 Workflow System Integration Coordination across mechanical, electrical, and controls disciplines Interface understanding (building, operator, procurement) Project Execution Work breakdown and prioritization Takes initiative in model delivery and helps in project planning Change/risk management and site readiness Works directly with customers and other disciplines when needed Communication & Collaboration Strong cross-functional teamwork Fluent in English communication Client/supplier coordination in BIM Able to guide junior engineers and clearly explain modeling logic Quality & Safety Design for safety, ergonomics, and standards compliance Maintains high design quality and documentation consistency Continuous Improvement Leads knowledge transfer and supports training for new tools or practices Analytical thinking and problem-solving Process/tooling optimization Soft Skills Requirements Communication Clear, structured communication Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences Collaboration Strong team player across multidisciplinary teams Builds effective working relationships with internal and external partners Leadership & Ownership Takes initiative, leads tasks, and makes sound decisions Acts as go-to person; leads modeling-related topics Problem Solving Analytical mindset and solutions-oriented under pressure Quickly identifies and resolves advanced Revit issues Adaptability Manages changing priorities and dynamic work environments Attention to Detail Maintains high quality and accuracy in designs Delivers clean, accurate, and clash-free models Time Management Delivers on time, multitasks effectively Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field. Experience in baggage/logistics automation or material handling systems (preferred) 5–6 years of Revit and BIM experience in layout or coordination 1+ years in team support, mentoring, or leading small team. Fluent in English – written and verbal About Vanderlande: Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey: from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other. Website: www.vanderlande.com What we offer: Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice: Competitive Salary Package 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including: 22 paid leave days 8 sick/casual leave days Applicable government holidays Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance. Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills. Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage. Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives Opportunity to collaborate globally. How we work We work by three values: Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say. Ready to apply? Are you interested in this position?
